sources.snippet: ivrit.ai We took to the task of fine-tuning OpenAI's Whisper v3 Turbo model. Our initial failures — and subsequent discoveries — prompted a set of changes to the current known methods for fine-tuning Whisper. In this article we share our findings, as well as a complete recipe for training Whisper's turbo version successfully.
